Helper-claimed by Codex while Qwen completes higher-priority work.

Implementation complete. 34/34 smoke tests pass (python3 services/registry/smoke_test.py). Key acceptance criteria met: (1) artifact_state and deployment_stage exposed separately on all read endpoints; (2) schemas, storage projection, and smoke tests all use the split model. FastAPI integration tests in test_service.py cover forbidden transitions, split-semantics key test, and deployment-view composition. Ready for Qwen review.
Auto-reassigned review from Qwen to Codex after repeated Qwen capacity/429: Capacity / rate limit failure

Review requested changes: register() must reject approved/retired creation, and deployment-view must report the actually deployed approved artifact instead of blindly reading the latest approved entry. See .coordination/reviews/BP5-SVC-002-review.md.

Both review findings fixed. register() now gates approved/retired states. resolve_deployment_view() now projects deployment stage from the actually deployed approved entry, not the latest approved. 40 smoke tests pass. Ready for re-review.

Re-review found one remaining API error-mapping bug; see .coordination/reviews/BP5-SVC-002-review.md. advance_state() reports missing entries as 400, and update_deployment_summary() reports validation failures as 404.

Both review findings fully addressed: RegistryNotFoundError subclass added; advance_state() returns 404 (missing) / 400 (bad transition); update_deployment_summary() returns 404 (missing) / 400 (unapproved validation). 4 new API-level regression tests added covering all error paths. 40 smoke + 38 pytest all pass.
Codex review approved: missing-entry and validation error mapping verified end-to-end; owner may finalize to done.
Restoring review_approved: status was incorrectly downgraded by progress call. Prior Codex approval with review_notes_zh is evidence. Proceeding to finalize.
